data.source_text_main_point: Startup Joost is advancing the Internet TV model by securing content deals and leveraging peer-to-peer technology to offer flexible, on-demand programming that balances consumer choice with industry control, though it currently lacks the high-quality content of traditional cable and relies on advertising revenue.

statements.key_statement: Joost attempts to balance consumer flexibility with industry content control via peer-to-peer technology, though it currently lacks high-quality content and relies on advertising.
statements.long_statement: The entertainment industry and consumers have conflicting needs regarding television distribution, with the former requiring content control and the latter seeking increased flexibility; the startup Joost attempts to resolve this tension by leveraging peer-to-peer technology to deliver on-demand programming, yet the service currently suffers from lower content quality compared to established cable systems and must generate revenue through advertising.
